mapper.sql: store_key, pack_key, input_hash, state_json, review_items, folded_at, written_back
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ont_state (store_key, pack_key, input_hash, state_json, review_items, folded_at, written_back) VALUES ( #{row.storeKey}, #{row.packKey}, #{row.inputHash}, #{row.stateJson}::jsonb, #{row.reviewItems}::jsonb, #{row.foldedAt}, #{row.writtenBack} ) ON CONFLICT (store_key) DO UPDATE SET pack_key = EXCLUDED.pack_key, input_hash = EXCLUDED.input_hash, state_json = EXCLUDED.state_json, review_items = EXCLUDED.review_items, folded_at = EXCLUDED.folded_at, written_back = EXCLUDED.written_back
mapper.update: UPDATE ont_state SET written_back = true WHERE store_key = #{storeKey}
